column1: # EdAcc accent label -> entry name in data/entries.tsv.
# EdAcc tags each speaker by self-described accent, which mixes two different
# things: nativised English varieties, which are entries in this game, and the
# speaker's first language, which is not. Only the nativised varieties are
# mapped here. Everything else EdAcc offers is dropped by the builder, since
# data/entries.tsv excludes learner accents on purpose: guessing where a
# Spanish-accented English speaker is from is guessing their first language,
# which the language entries already cover.
# Dropped on that rule, with their take counts: Vietnamese 36, Italian 36,
# Spanish 30, Eastern European 30, Lithuanian 12, Egyptian 12, Chinese 12,
# Romanian 6, Israeli 6, Indonesian 6, Catalan 6, Bulgarian 6, European 5,
# Dutch 4, Japanese 1, and "Don't know" 12.
# Indonesian English (12 takes) is nativised but has no entry, so it is also
# dropped. Add it to entries.tsv first if it should be playable.
# edacc_label<TAB>entry
